name: Tenma Saki
source:
Saki is a bright and cheerful mood-maker who never stops smiling. She was born with a weak body and couldn't attend middle school, but she's finally become healthy enough to attend high school. She looks forward to reacquainting with her childhood friends and experiencing high school with them, but...

She is the keyboardist for Leo/need.

[From in-game profile]
